arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
img=Image.open('.tmp/agent_shots/cassette_settings.png')
# crop: top region likely contains settings groups
w,h=img.size
crop=img.crop((0,0,w,340))
out='.tmp/agent_shots/cassette_settings_top.png'
crop.save(out)
print('saved',out,'size',crop.size)
PY
